maya: FYI pushed a cross-region KV-cache run for microburst-y workloads. TL;DR: warmup masks long-seq miss behavior, stochastic-evict helps p99 in eu-west but hurts throughput in us-east on INT8. link to raw artifacts: S3 (private).

bench-bot: run-complete Summary: 6 regions x 2 GPUs x 2 quants x 3 eviction algos. artifacts/2134567890/

raj: can you paste the small table here? quick scan of artifacts will be slower. @maya :eyes:

maya: sure — pasted trimmed CSV below (seqlen buckets: 1-32,33-128,129-512,512+). note: "hit%" is prefix kv hitrate measured at serve-time, warmup included.

```
Region,GPU,Quant,Evict,Kernel,SeqlenBucket,Hit%,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens_per_s
us-east,H100,FP16,lru,fused-attn,1-32,93.4,10.8,28.1,64.5,138000
us-east,H100,INT8,lru,fused-attn,1-32,92.0,11.6,30.2,71.3,142500
us-east,H100,INT8,stochastic,fused-attn,129-512,41.2,26.1,88.0,220.6,48000
eu-west,A100,FP16,lru,split-kernel,129-512,47.8,25.9,92.4,205.1,51000
eu-west,A100,INT8,stochastic,split-kernel,129-512,58.9,23.4,74.2,143.5,53000
apac-south,H100,FP16,hot-reserve,fused-attn,512+,21.3,74.2,240.1,520.9,9800
apac-south,H100,INT8,hot-reserve,fused-attn,512+,18.7,82.5,281.3,610.2,10300
```

maya: key observations: 1) warmup is boosting hit% for 1-32 buckets — production replay without warmup drops those by ~6-8pts. 2) stochastic-evict increases hit% for mid seqlen (129-512) in eu-west (A100), lowering p99 significantly vs lru, but in us-east H100 it increases CPU overhead during bursts and reduces aggregate tkn/s. 3) INT8 increases tokens_per_s slightly on short seqs but seems to degrade hit% and p99 on long seqs (>512) in some regions — looks like quantized KV keys are a bit noisier in the compare hash/kernel path.

liam: question: were traces synthetic or production? warmup bias matters a lot.

maya: traced-based but we allowed a 30s warmup phase before measurement (past runs did that). that likely explains the optimistic 1-32 hit rates. reran quick no-warmup subset — here's the delta for us-east H100 FP16 lru: 1-32 hit% dropped 7.1 pts, p95 up ~+6ms.

liam: ok please add a run with warmup=0 and an extended cold-run (simulate 10% of traffic cold) — we need realistic miss tail. use --trace-replay --cold-ratio=0.1.

maya: command I used for CI snippet:
```
./kvbench --model redwood-7b --region us-east --gpu H100 --quant INT8 --kernel fused-attn --evict stochastic --trace replay.tar.gz --warmup 30 --duration 600
```

eva: noted a quality regression in our automated evals when INT8 + stochastic-evict combined on long sequences — subtle token drift on LD50 tests. putting a failing eval id in the run artifacts: eval/2134567890/longseq-int8-drift.

chris: action items: 1) @maya re-run matrix with warmup=0 and cold-ratio 0.1 for us-east & eu-west on H100/A100 FP16/INT8. 2) @raj add a console metric kv_miss_ratio_by_seqlen and a p99_kv_miss_latency gauge. 3) bench-bot should attach per-run kernel-level CPU steal and GPU utilization. 4) eva to run quant-eval suite for redwood-7b-int8 longseq. target ETA for next iteration: EOD Wed. :rocket:

maya: ack — scheduling the runs now, will post updated trimmed CSV once complete. thanks for the quick review. :thumbsup:
